card.name: Just before vein and varices terms
card.fires_on: Words right before a vein-related term such as varices, varicose veins, or revascularization in sclerotherapy or vascular text. It fires on linking words (of, or, the, extensive) and on the start of varicose or varices.

modes.label: Linking word before vein term
modes.description: A small word like of, or, the, or an opening parenthesis comes just before a vein or varices word.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Local ETHAMOLIN Injection sclerotherapy<< of>> esophageal varices should be performed

modes.label: Partway through varicose words
modes.description: The first pieces of varicose, varices, varicosities, or reticular, where the rest of the word is still to come.
